# pangolin_alert_rule (Data Source)

Looks up a single alert rule by ID, including its email recipients and webhook actions.

> **Note:** Webhook credentials are returned in clear by the server and end up in the Terraform state (marked sensitive).

> **Note:** Requires Pangolin Enterprise Edition on self-host (or Pangolin Cloud). Community Edition servers answer 404 on the alert rule endpoints.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pangolin_alert_rule" "example" {
  id = 12
}

output "alert_rule_recipients" {
  value = {
    users  = data.pangolin_alert_rule.example.user_ids
    roles  = data.pangolin_alert_rule.example.role_ids
    emails = data.pangolin_alert_rule.example.emails
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (Number) The numeric alert rule ID to look up.

### Read-Only

- `cooldown_seconds` (Number) Minimum delay in seconds between two notifications.
- `created_at` (Number) Creation timestamp (epoch milliseconds).
- `emails` (List of String) External email addresses notified by email.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the rule is enabled.
- `event_type` (String) The event that triggers the rule (e.g. `site_offline`, `health_check_unhealthy`, `resource_degraded`).
- `health_check_ids` (List of Number) IDs of the watched health checks. Empty for non-health-check rules and for rules watching every health check.
- `last_triggered_at` (Number) Last time the rule fired (epoch milliseconds), null if never.
- `name` (String) The alert rule name.
- `resource_ids` (List of Number) IDs of the watched resources. Empty for non-resource rules and for rules watching every resource.
- `role_ids` (List of Number) IDs of the roles whose members are notified by email.
- `site_ids` (List of Number) IDs of the watched sites. Empty for non-site rules and for rules watching every site.
- `updated_at` (Number) Last update timestamp (epoch milliseconds).
- `user_ids` (List of String) IDs of the users notified by email.
- `webhook_actions` (Attributes List) Webhooks called when the rule fires, in creation order. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--webhook_actions))

<a id="nestedatt--webhook_actions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `webhook_actions`

Read-Only:

- `auth_type` (String) Authentication: `none`, `bearer`, `basic` or `custom`.
- `basic_credentials` (String, Sensitive) `username:password` basic credentials.
- `bearer_token` (String, Sensitive) Bearer token.
- `body_template` (String) Custom request body template, null when the default payload is used.
- `custom_header_name` (String) Custom auth header name.
- `custom_header_value` (String, Sensitive) Custom auth header value.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the webhook is called.
- `headers` (Map of String) Extra headers, keyed by header name.
- `id` (Number) Numeric webhook action ID.
- `last_sent_at` (Number) Last successful call (epoch milliseconds), null if never.
- `method` (String) HTTP method (`POST` when the config does not set one).
- `url` (String) The webhook URL.
